title: Scroll Animation by @vanschneider: I'm still love this landing page for our mobile app. Keeps things simp
notes:
I'm still love this landing page for our mobile app. Keeps things simple and focuses on the use cases that matter most on mobile. We like to see the mobile app more of a companion to the main experience and about being there when you need it. Everything was built around the native share sheet experience because thats what you will likely use the most. All the rest of the magic happens behind the scenes and then you can easily revisit your things on desktop/web (or on mobile of course). Wherever you are, just hit the share button (screenshots, articles, products, images, tweets etc.) and its saved to your mind. All the sorting, labeling, and polishing happens automatically while you get on with your day.

Designer: @vanschneider. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
